episodeTitle.en: Behind the product: Replit | Amjad Masad (co-founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品背后的故事：Replit | 阿米贾德·马萨德（联合创始人兼CEO）

guestBioOfficial.en: Amjad Masad is the co-founder and CEO of Replit, a browser-based coding environment that allows anyone to write and deploy code. Replit has 34 million users globally and is one of the fastest-growing developer communities in the world. Prior to Replit, Amjad worked at Facebook, where he led the JavaScript infrastructure team and contributed to popular open-source developer tools. Additionally, he played a key role as a founding engineer at the online coding school Codecademy. In our conversation, Amjad shares: • A live demo of Replit in action
guestBioOfficial.zh: 阿米贾德·马萨德是Replit的联合创始人兼CEO，这是一款基于浏览器的编码环境，允许任何人编写和部署代码。Replit在全球拥有3400万用户，是全球发展最快的开发者社区之一。在加入Replit之前，阿米贾德曾在Facebook工作，领导JavaScript基础设施团队，并为流行的开源开发者工具做出贡献。此外，他还在在线编程学校Codecademy担任创始工程师。在我们的对谈中，阿米贾德将分享：• Replit实时演示

title.en: Behind the product: Replit | Amjad Masad (co-founder and CEO)
title.zh: 产品背后的故事：Replit | 阿米贾德·马萨德（联合创始人兼CEO）

summary.en: Amjad demos what Replit can do today—letting anyone build and ship software, including full startups, with minimal technical skill—which he argues will blow people's minds. He predicts the bottleneck shifts from making things to generating ideas, and imagines a future where someone runs a billion-dollar company with zero employees. The conversation explores the profound implications for the future of product development, product management, and founders as AI lowers the cost of building.
summary.zh: Amjad 演示了 Replit 今天的能力——让任何人都能用极少的技术技能构建并发布软件（包括完整的创业项目），他认为这会让人大开眼界。他预测瓶颈将从“做出来”转向“想出来”，并想象未来有人用零员工运营一家十亿美元公司。对话深入探讨了 AI 降低构建成本后，对产品开发、产品管理和创始人的深远影响。
